attrs.value: 2 Preflight
✈️ 2 — Preflight, every spawn, in order
x:crew-lead § preflight · a spawn first reads models.md, briefing.md, watching.md, shared-tree.md

♻️ 1 · reuse or spawn?
the grid in models.md

🔑 2 · trust key
the exact folder in ~/.claude.json

🧊 3 · spare age
a bg-spare over a day old → daemon stop

🩺 4 · app essentials
apps-essentials.ts passes

📂 5 · tier + cwd
cd <repo> && claude --bg, one command

🪐 6 · the spawn word
his pick of signed chunks is the spawn; a quick lane's pick says verifier yes or no

❓ exit lines sealed?
no exit lines → no spawn

📋 7 · brief file
x brief check + wish-cover pass

⌨️ 9 · the argv
-n, the prompt, then --remote-control

🔀 8 · pr mode
a side-lane or shift brief says plain or stacked (a trial, 2+ dependent parts)

🏷️ 10 · the name
<mode> <role> <ticket> <role>: <what>

🎫 11 · ticket id
rides the branch and the pr body

🪪 12 · identity
coder token, done-comment cap

🛼 13 · glide
link the member to its lane card
1 Door
🚪 1 — Which door?
x:crew-lead § the doors · disposable or watchable, never research vs code · one coder by default, two with a reason, never three

🦉 work to hand off
cclio has a job for someone

❓ disposable or watchable?
the one split that picks a door

🐝 disposable
a subagent, fork or worktree agent → band 6

⌨️ claude --bg
the default door for coding

🙋‍♂️ the Code-tab door
dima opens it, pastes a brief pointer

🙋‍♂️ a mods coder
always a quick lane on main: one chunk, then parks for the 5h pace
a desktop thread cclio opens with start_session and closes with archive_session; a shift parks a mods chunk

☁️ claude --cloud
an anthropic vm; cannot message back

🍴 a side channel
cclio:side-channel opens one, fresh or forked; banner, edits only in its own worktree, side-labelled pocket items, the boot takes them over

🎼 the sidecars
ccrow + composer start in cclio:boot; composer takes chores only from «🦉 cclio» exactly

♻️ a pick-up is a spawn
its first message inits the role
3 Brief
📋 3 — The brief
x:crew-lead briefing.md · what goes in, then every word checked before it is sent

📋 role contract first
/x:crew-coder … — only the first slash expands

📄 every other skill
named in plain words

🔎 names its verifier
on a verifier yes

🛑 a «not yours» fence
what another member owns

📝 first reply: skills loaded
one line per spawn → a test drive

🧪 15 checks before sending
every verb --help, fetch main first …

📄 context pointers
never a restated ticket
4 Run
🏃 4 — Running the lane
briefing § watching · watching.md · crew-dna · subscribe, never poll; three round trips, more means the brief was wrong

🔧 the coder works
a side lane in its worktree (pr); a quick lane on main, committing as it goes, cclio pushes

🔔 it pings
[done] [blocked] [ask] [progress]

📡 «opened» or «final»
pr-watch on a side lane, the coder's «final» on a quick lane → cclio spawns the verifier (main:<sha>)

🔁 coder ↔ verifier
rounds, cap 3; cclio hears none; a round-3 stop is cclio's call, told to dima as info

🔔 an idle notice
notify_when_idle, one-shot

🩺 idle-check.ts
stall or fine?

🦉 nudge it
the next step, the same turn

🙋‍♂️ still silent ~5 min
dima, or re-brief / respawn
5 End
🏁 5 — Ending
crew-dna · briefing § the pr · watching § stopping · a watch lives until its pr merges, never until its coder stops

✅ verifier clean
pr-watch --verified on a pr; its exit line on a quick lane

🦉 no review request
dima is never added; the gate in pr-flow.md decides

🔀 land
a pr merges by the gate in pr-flow.md, risky paths named, a self-edit or the brake waits for dima; a quick lane: cclio pushes main

🛑 claude stop <jobId>
then ls: the registry file is gone

📝 retro + glide end
beside the lane plan in ~/.local/state/x/lanes; the glide ends at siesta

⚡ a quick lane, no pr
«final» → ⚡ 🔎 verify: main:<sha>, clean a Linear comment; then cclio pushes main
6 Subagents
🐝 6 — Subagents
x:crew-subagent · open to every member · disposable: runs inside your session, dies with it

🦉 a chore or a read
a big read, a bounded question

❓ pick the card
helper-lite · helper · researcher · retro · scout

⚙️ a lean start
omitClaudeMd, effort medium

🍴 a fork?
only with why-fork:, or refused

✅ done
answer read, checked, folded

📄 fan-out
x10 ≈ 4× tokens, 5× faster; x25+ → Workflow
Legend
🧭 Legend

🙋‍♂️ dima
decides or acts

🦉 cclio
does it

⚙️ a script
a hook or a check

🔧 a crew member
coder, verifier, …

📄 a file
a rule or a reference

🔔 an event
a trigger

⚠️ a weak spot
my reading, not in the files
PM 1 Intake
📬 1 — Intake: a drop becomes a pocket item
craft-fleet-flow stage 1 · craft-pm § wishes · habit-shared-files § the pocket · cclio:boot step 3

🙋‍♂️ a drop
inbox.md in the vault, or mid-prompt

🎼 composer grooms it
every wish-bearing prompt; his raw words land in the notes at once

🦉 folded into W-lines
his words, one point a line, ❓ for his questions; copied, never paraphrased

🌠 a pocket item is born
Backlog.md · pocket-add.ts · size + now/next/later

⚙️ pocket-check
reds a breach: now ≤ 3, open uncapped, a stale state, a W-line unaccounted, an open item behind a ticket

🐬 wishkeeper, boot mode
every drop landed, kept in meaning

❓ its home, at the halt's sort
linear owns it → a body line of its ticket · freebie (1–5 calls) solved now · today/tomorrow stays · later → linear

✅ the pocket is today + tomorrow
later → linear in its milestone; nothing comes back from linear
PM 2 Shape
🥊 2 — Shape: a wish becomes buildable
craft-fleet-flow stages 2–3 · root invariant 3 · cclio:shape-idea · grilling · craft-pm § wishes

🔔 shape-idea, a pick
the fold proposes it per wish: a new app, a feature, a change to a product part

🦉 cclio:shape-idea
the want, a grill, prior art, the cut, the done test

🔁 grill rounds
matt's grilling: a proposal file, ccrow reviews it, the refined round prints once

❓ «shaped»
his word
is the gate

🎨 design, when it earns it
designer-interview → boards → his pick

⚙️ wish-cover.ts + its hook
a first use copies its W-lines word for word, from the pocket or the ticket; reds a missing one

✅ first use is word-checked
was 9.4 % lost at the grill (10-21); the hook fires on every spec and proposal

📄 ? lines answered
a wish reaching to-spec with an open ? is the failure
PM 3 Ticket
🎫 3 — Ticket: the want gets its linear home
craft-fleet-flow stage 4 · cclio:pm § the fields · pm/references/body.md · the sorting phase

🦉 search before a create
the dupe, the parent, the relations up front

🎫 born in Triage
x as cclio, never --state; promotion is dima's

📄 the body, a spec seed
lane · wish block of W-lines · why · stories · decided · 🎯 done test · out · refs · ## signed

🦉 every field, every touch
role, kind, p3, size, project, parent, 🎑 milestone

🦉 cclio:shape-lane
grill the chunk, then ✍️ sign it: done test, milestone, lane, repo, its order (blocks)

⚙️ x brief preflight
🦭 the seal at dispatch: the spec's exit lines gradable; no exit lines, no spawn

🙋‍♂️ the sorting phase
cclio proposes the order, dima corrects it

✅ one home at a time
pocket item → ticket: «ticket: FRM-N», dies the turn the ticket is born
PM 4 Hand-off
🛼 4 — Hand-off: a lane picks its path
craft-fleet-flow § freebie, quick lane, side lane, stage 5 · pm/references/body.md § ticket ↔ spec · x:crew-lead

❓ which kind?
freebie · quick lane
side lane

📄 to-spec
.scratch/<feature>/spec.md; wish: FRM-N, its W-lines cited, wish-cover exit 0

🔧 the coder runs to-tickets
slices in .scratch/<feature>/issues/, never linear

📋 x brief check
its one home: crew-lead → the crew column, 3 Brief

📄 the lane plan → the glide card
~/.local/state/x/lanes/<feature>/, outside every checkout; glide copies it (auto: FRM-410)

✅ cclio 🟢 greenlights the order
the coder drafts lane-plan.md, cclio reorders against what comes next

✅ steers land in the file
dima's, cclio's and proxied steers, asks, wisps → ## not greenlit the same turn; cclio greenlights again

✅ one word per lane
main lane ours · side lane (pr) · quick lane (no pr) · shift on afk
PM 5 Land and fold
🏁 5 — Land, look, fold: the wish reaches dima
craft-fleet-flow stages 8–10 · pm/references/closing.md · habit-shared-files · cclio:halt

🔀 land — cclio approves + merges
verifier clean (≤3 rounds, a local review each), ci once at «final»; a self-edit or the brake waits for dima

👀 the look card
what, where, try, proven, not checked + a shot; risky paths named

🙋‍♂️ the ask-guard
each ask of his printed with its home before a close

🎫 close, with a closing word
proposed, never performed; 3 auto-close cases

🌠 its pocket item → done
dead the turn its ticket was born: ticket: FRM-N + a close: line

📝 fold the lesson
a guard, a verb, a check, a ticket; the 🗺️ board redrawn once the steers land

⚙️ x fleet flow --days 14
the done test: #dima-caught, #brief, pr median down

✅ wish-loss guards
M1 + M2 in pocket-check, the word hook; M3 weekly audit from 10-28

⚙️ the halt's lingering sweep
In Progress, landed, asks still open → Todo; a ↩️ line names why and what is left
PM 0 Roadmap
🧭 0 — Roadmap → milestone: what we work on, in what order
dima-strategy § the roadmap · craft-pm § milestones first · cclio:pm (milestone fields) · boot's milestone-health block

🧭 the roadmap initiative
nine steps, the cli beside them; «now» names where we stand

🙋‍♂️ a step opens on his tick
a close asks «open N+1?»; then its start date + first milestone, queued; status follows the queue

📄 projects are standing
linear's project complete is never used; only milestones complete

🎑 milestones first
create, move, close ask «which milestone?»; x-mod-guard refuses a bare one where the project has milestones (FRM-417)

🎑 born at 2+ tickets
one flow's related tickets, named by the outcome dima notices, never a number

⚙️ the boot's milestone health
flags an empty one, an unplaced ticket, a number-name, more than 5 open

🙋‍♂️ an empty milestone
linear computes done, no close: a ⚠️ delete ask, per milestone

🎫 → band 1, the tickets
later → linear, in its milestone; the pocket holds today + tomorrow
